name: lightmd
description: A LightEdit-style single-file Markdown viewer built on Electron

scripts.package: electron-packager . LightMD --platform=darwin --out=dist --overwrite --app-bundle-id=local.lightmd.viewer --app-category-type=public.app-category.developer-tools --app-copyright="© 2026 Jay Gaha" --extend-info=build/Info.plist --icon=build/icon.icns --ignore="^/(test|build|dist|bin|scripts|\.remember)(/|$)" --ignore="^/(README\.md|\.gitignore)$" && codesign --force --deep --sign - dist/LightMD-darwin-*/LightMD.app
